svg.title: Indonesian Throughflow gate resolvability
svg.desc: A local equal-area map audits five candidate Indonesian Throughflow screens. Timor is a usable surface hint; Makassar and Lifamatola show surface sign conflicts; Lombok and Ombai are underresolved.
svg.metadata: Natural Earth 1:10m SHA-256 1ac90796408bc6ad6911d69448485d3c4dbf2190370080368a09976e1c9f7416. This is a grid-support audit, not validation of the geographic section. Older OSCAR 2017.0 nominal-15-m velocity cannot represent full-depth sill geometry, tidal mixing, temperature/salinity transformation, volume transport, heat transport, or the simultaneous INSTANT observational estimate. Narrow passages may require a finer native model or mooring product.
svg.text: OSW / INDONESIAN HEAT ROUTES · M2 RESOLUTION AUDIT
Before arrows become a story, ask whether the grid can hold the strait.

g.text: DECLARED POSITIVE: SOUTHWARD TOWARD INDIAN OCEAN
DECLARED POSITIVE: WESTWARD TOWARD INDIAN OCEAN
DECLARED POSITIVE: WESTWARD TOWARD INDIAN OCEAN
masked in one or more fields
screen with contrary annual surface sign

svg.text: Lombok and Ombai do not have enough native wet samples for a serious M2 section. Makassar and Lifamatola warn that surface velocity is not the full-depth throughflow. Timor alone clears this screen.
OSCAR 2017.0 · 71 FIVE-DAY FIELDS · DEC 2017–NOV 2018 · NOMINAL 15 M · 1/3° GRID · LOCAL LAMBERT AZIMUTHAL EQUAL AREA · NATURAL EARTH 1:10M LAND
